(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles having a size distribution of 8-200 micrometers; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to a surface of an electronic component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the surface of the electronic component. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a binder, and a carrier, wherein the particle to binder ratio is about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier is about 10 ml per gram of particles, and wherein the cavity-generating particles have a size of 8-200 micrometers. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive material selected from the group consisting of premixed solder paste and epoxy. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity-generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass, and their alloys.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity-generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, having a size of 8-200 micrometers.
